name: SingIt
description: SingIt: x402 USDC payments for AI agents, with spending limits. MCP server (free tools without a key; paid tools within owner-set key limits) and an OpenAI-compatible x402 API: 200+ models, web search, images and speech on Base and Solana. This is a discovery card, not an A2A task endpoint. The interface protocolVersion is the MCP version, 2025-06-18.

skills.name: Key spending limits
skills.description: get_limits and get_receipts read key limits and spend. Caps apply only to calls with that key to SingIt MCP and its /v1 endpoint; they do not limit spending elsewhere or protect an agent’s own wallet.
examples: Show my daily spending limit and receipts.

skills.name: Free model answers
skills.description: Limited free model answers without a wallet or key.

skills.name: Paid model answers over x402
skills.description: Pay per call in USDC on Base or Solana through the x402 API. Use singit/auto to pick a model by tier.
examples: Choose a model with singit/auto and explain x402.

skills.name: Web search and page reading
skills.description: Paid calls with a SingIt key and search scope on Base or Solana.
examples: Search the web for recent AI research.

skills.name: Price lookups
skills.description: Free crypto, metal and FX price lookups without a key.
examples: What is the current ETH price?

x402.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
x402.description: x402 v2 payment signature from the 402 response; USDC on Base or Solana.

bearer.description: SingIt API key (sk_singit_...) for the MCP server and app.singitai.app/v1; the owner's limits apply to calls made with it.
